title: Gaussian priors from nonlinear PDEs with the semiclassical approximation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33400v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Probabilistic numerical methods for partial differential equations (PDE) combines the governing physics with observations to treat solving the PDE as a Bayesian inverse problem. This allows techniques to quantify the uncertainty in the field reconstruction under model-form error. In the majority of cases, a Gaussian prior is assigned to the field of interest, and Bayes's theorem in the infinite-dimensional setting is used to derive the posterior. While Gaussians have been shown to be well-suited for linear PDEs, a similar treatment for nonlinear PDEs remains open-ended. In this work, study the use of the semiclassical approximation to construct Gaussian priors from variational energies or integrated square residuals for probabilistic numerics. translated_title: 基于半经典近似从非线性偏微分方程构造高斯先验
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.33400v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：偏微分方程（PDE）的概率数值方法将控制方程的物理规律与观测数据相结合，把求解PDE视为一个贝叶斯逆问题。这使得人们能够在模型形式误差存在的情况下量化场重建中的不确定性。在大多数情况下，会给感兴趣的场分配一个高斯先验，并在无穷维设置下利用贝叶斯定理推导后验分布。虽然高斯分布已被证明非常适合线性PDE，但对非线性PDE的类似处理仍是一个悬而未决的问题。在本工作中，我们研究利用半经典近似，从变分能量或积分平方残差中构造用于概率数值方法的高斯先验。该先验通过在稳定解附近对PDE能量进行展开并揭示出高斯形式而得到。随后，我们分析了所得先验的不同特性，以及它们在……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出利用半经典近似，通过在稳定解附近展开非线性PDE的变分能量或积分平方残差来构造高斯先验，从而将贝叶斯不确定性量化的概率数值方法拓展到非线性偏微分方程领域。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes constructing Gaussian priors for nonlinear PDEs via the semiclassical approximation—expanding the PDE's variational energy or integrated square residual about a stable solution—thereby extending probabilistic numerical methods with Bayesian uncertainty quantification to the nonlinear setting.
